note: PG3 layered effects (GG 2026-10-28: the charge and the blast 'sound too basic, i wnat them to feel more powerful, also damadge sound efefct or hitting enemy'). Each output clip is a mix of separately generated ElevenLabs layers (game audio practice: sub / body punch, transient crack, mechanical or electric sweetener, tail; RESEARCH.md section 4). Tools/pg3/layer-mix.cjs generates every layer, then mixes them with ffmpeg (gain dB, delay ms) and a -1 dBTP limiter. The output replaces Assets/Resources/Audio/PG3/<id>.mp3; the single-take originals stay under Research/2026-10-28-pg3-audio/raw/sfx/.
